_comment: Generic pipeline settings — no URLs, safe to commit to this public repo. The actual reference-blog list lives in sources.local.json (gitignored). See content/ideas/sources.example.json for that file's shape.

conventions._min_internal_links_note: Cold start (devlog port, step 6): 0 until 3 posts exist on disk, then blog-lint.mjs applies the ramp above automatically. An unsatisfiable gate would just get disabled and never come back — this ramps it up instead.
conventions._bands_note: Left wide open — no corpus yet to derive real word/H2 bands from. Recalibrate at 5 posts.
conventions._faq_note: Dropped for the devlog: it was SEO rich-results bait, not part of what carries over per _port/blog-pipeline-port-devlog.md section 3.
conventions._disclosure_note: Repurposed, not deleted, per devlog doc section 2.6: when a post names a tool/engine/other studio (any term in disclosure_trigger_terms), lint requires a short 'what I use and why' line instead of the origin's competitor-neutrality disclosure.

_publishing_cadence_note: The user's own publishing commitment (devlog doc section 2.7) — enforced as a hard rule in .claude/skills/blog-write/SKILL.md, separate from cadence_days (which only paces the reference-blog research reminder).
